episodes.task: Motion-only route ablation; ignore the simulator's manipulation objective. Move the EEF from its actual initial pose to world xyz [0.10, -0.32, 0.12] while preserving the current orientation. Use exactly one ik_preview_check for this endpoint with position_tolerance_m=0.01, orientation_tolerance_rad=0.30, preserve_current_orientation=true, and check_endpoint_collision=true. If the preview authorizes execution, call move_to with that ik_receipt_id, tolerance=0.01, ori_tolerance=0.30, and enable_collision_check=true. Do not call perception, grasp, gripper, or follow_eef_trajectory tools. Inspect the execution receipt, report reached or not reached, and stop; official LIBERO task success is not expected.

Motion-only route ablation; ignore the simulator's manipulation objective. Move the EEF from its actual initial pose to world xyz [0.10, -0.32, 0.12] while preserving the current orientation. Choose the number and coordinates of 2-5 generic route endpoints from current visual and geometric evidence; do not assign phase or stage labels. Preview every endpoint separately with ik_preview_check using position_tolerance_m=0.01, orientation_tolerance_rad=0.30, preserve_current_orientation=true, and check_endpoint_collision=true. If all endpoints authorize execution, call follow_eef_trajectory exactly once with the ordered ik_receipt_ids, tolerance=0.01, ori_tolerance=0.30, num_steps_per_waypoint=100, and enable_collision_check=true. Do not call move_to, perception, grasp, or gripper tools. Inspect the trajectory receipt, report reached or not reached, and stop; official LIBERO task success is not expected.
